definition: a close friend you do things with
description: On a snowy mountain top at sunset, five young men in bright retro ski suits in purple, teal and blue are piled together on an old beige sofa in the snow, laughing and shouting. One lies across the others' laps, one pours a hot drink from a flask that spills onto the snow, and others raise enamel mugs. A shaggy grey dog in a bobble hat stands on the back of the sofa and shakes its head. A stone cairn is behind them, and backpacks lie beside the sofa as snow blows past.

de.answer: Der Hund balanciert auf dem Sofa.
de.question: Was macht der Hund?
